_comment: Instruction template pools. `train` sentences are sampled into episodes; `holdout` sentences are NEVER collected -- they exist only for the unseen-instruction evaluation. Every collected episode records which pool it came from, so a hold-out sentence can always be filtered back out. Minimum 3 train + 1 holdout per level. Levels where the sentence *chooses the object* also list a `targets` map; load_instruction_targets() refuses to load a level whose sentences are not all mapped.

train: put the red cube on the blue disc
place the red cube on the blue disc
move the red cube onto the blue disc
holdout: set the red cube down on the blue disc

train: put the red cube on the blue disc
place the red cube on the blue disc
move the red cube onto the blue disc
holdout: set the red cube down on the blue disc

train: pick the orange bar up across its narrow side and put it on the blue disc
grab the orange bar by its long narrow face and place it on the blue disc
put the orange bar on the blue disc, holding it across the narrow side
holdout: get the orange bar onto the blue disc

train: take the red cube out of the narrow slot and put it on the blue disc
reach between the two walls and place the red cube on the blue disc
pick the red cube up from between the walls and put it on the blue disc
holdout: get the red cube out of the gap and onto the blue disc

train: put the red cube into the grey container
place the red cube inside the container
drop the red cube into the box
holdout: get the red cube into the container

train: stack the red cube on top of the yellow cube
put the red cube on top of the yellow cube
place the red cube onto the yellow cube
holdout: set the red cube down on the yellow one

_p2_comment: P2 is the language-referenced level: two same-sized cubes are present and the sentence says which one. `targets` maps every sentence to the body it names; an unmapped sentence would make the language ablation silently meaningless.

train: put the red cube on the blue disc
move the red cube onto the blue disc
place the red cube on the blue disc
put the yellow cube on the blue disc
move the yellow cube onto the blue disc
place the yellow cube on the blue disc
holdout: set the red cube down on the blue disc
take the yellow cube and set it down on the blue disc

train: move the grey cube off the red cube and put the red cube on the blue disc
clear the grey cube out of the way, then put the red cube on the blue disc
take the grey cube off the top, then place the red cube on the blue disc
holdout: get the red cube out from under the grey cube and onto the blue disc

train: put the red cube on the blue disc, reaching past the grey wall
place the red cube on the blue disc from behind the grey wall
put the red cube on the blue disc even though the wall is in the way
holdout: get the red cube onto the blue disc past the wall
